integrity: The two exact risk kernels and sharp bound are proved analytically; a standalone exact-rational checker corroborates 19,525 polynomial configurations. An independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed deterministic curvature path with bounded derivative, a real Hilbert space and an exponential random step; oracle noise, stochastic directions, and full optimization convergence are not assessed. The endpoint-corrected rule requires two endpoint Hessian-vector products unless the first is cached.
title: Quadratic-exact exponential-step curvature transport: sharp noise kernels and a comparison of two unbiased estimators
